chapter_seo_title: Li Huowang Returns to Niuxin Village & Introduces Li Sui
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang finally returns to Niuxin Village, hoping for peace. But when he introduces Li Sui as his daughter, the homecoming takes a sharp turn into domestic chaos.
og_title: Li Huowang Returns to Niuxin Village & Introduces Li Sui
og_description: The homecoming we’ve all been waiting for… and the bombshell that shatters it.
twitter_title: "Mother." – Li Sui drops the word that breaks Bai Lingmiao.
twitter_description: Li Huowang returns home but his new "daughter" causes more trouble than any demon.

lore_anchors.definition: The fortified village that serves as the Bai family’s home base and Li Huowang’s primary refuge in the Dao-Twisted World.
A Black Tai Sui parasitic entity that Li Huowang considers his adopted daughter; she calls him “Dad” and now, Bai Lingmiao “Mother.”
A grotesque, sentient parasitic entity; considered a valuable alchemical ingredient in the Dao-Twisted World.
The secret society of liars whose name perverts the Daoist concept of “sitting in forgetfulness”; Hong Zhong is a member.
A scholarly storyteller and Li Huowang’s sworn brother; his moral clarity often serves as a foil to the world’s corruption.
The dog’s name, literally meaning “Steamed Bun”; a constant companion that now harbors a deep hatred for Li Sui.
The gruff patriarch of a traveling opera troupe who now lives in Niuxin Village under Li Huowang’s protection.
A traditional Chinese folk custom where one steps over a burning brazier to purify themselves of bad luck after a journey or a funeral.
